summary: {person} takes the first briefing at the airfield before setting out for the site.
realLife: Denton briefed Carter in the flight planning room at the Air National Guard facility in Middletown.
gates: An arriving executive and a field adviser are scheduled to meet at an airfield.
weights: A short interval between arrival and the site visit favors briefing at the airfield.
inGame: needs: where a visiting executive receives the first briefing.

turns.what: The executive takes the briefing before leaving home.
turns.pulledBy: The local official can reach the executive by phone before departure.
turns.writesBack: The travel record links to an earlier briefing.

turns.what: One adviser briefs the executive at the airfield and another joins at the site.
turns.pulledBy: The field specialist must remain on duty.
turns.writesBack: The visit log records two briefings with different speakers.
